verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair axis for a payments platform with a dashboard, but nothing in the evidence shows an AI assistant inside the Finix Dashboard or product that users can delegate tasks to. The documented MCP server lets external agents such as Claude Code answer questions about Finix APIs from the docs. That is an adjacent developer integration, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
